content:
elaine_cs: Heads-up on Halcyon renewal — they want split billing (Halcyon Inc. US / Halcyon GmbH DE). Key asks: reverse-charge VAT on the EU invoice, a PO for the subscription, CC for a 30-day pilot fee, and an SLA-credit clause tied to uptime under 99.9%. Procurement also wants KYC/vendor onboarding docs before final payment. Can we support reverse-charge + PO-first preference but allow CC pilot to start onboarding?

matt_sales: Good opportunity. Customer will take 12mo at quoted rate if we accept reverse-charge on EU invoices. They said PO ETA ~5 business days but want pilot to start immediately. They agreed CC for pilot if we mark it as "auth-only" until PO is received. Also they asked for an SLA Annex that converts credits into invoice adjustments rather than refunds.

rachel_fin: Finance: we can accept CC auth for the pilot fee and finalize after PO lands. For reverse-charge we need buyer VAT ID + EU billing contact. PO must be on file within 7 business days or we void provisioning and refund the auth. Please include the following invoice metadata (paste into contract ticket):
```
billing_split: "US: 70, DE: 30"
po_number: "TBD"
vat_reverse_charge: "true"
eu_vat_id: "<customer_vat_id>"
deposit_method: "card_auth"
```
Also require KYC packet (W-9 or W-8 + bank remit for ACH if applicable).

ian_legal: Legal ok to support reverse-charge but we need a short EU Tax Annex referencing reverse-charge mechanism and a separate SLA-Annex mapping uptime tiers to invoice credit calculations. Draft clause for EU Tax Annex (short):
```
EU Tax Annex: Customer represents it is the recipient of services for VAT purposes and agrees reverse-charge applies. Customer will provide a valid VAT identification number and any required local documentation.
```
SLA-Annex draft (short):
```
SLA Annex: If monthly availability falls below 99.9%, Customer is entitled to a service credit equal to X% of monthly fees for that month. Credits will be applied as invoice adjustments on the next billing cycle. Disputes must be raised within 15 business days.
```
Also ask that procurement email and KYC attachment be captured in the DocuSign envelope audit trail.

esign-bot: Template found: "Renewal-RevCharge-SLA-Annex". Can generate envelope with attachments (KYC), conditional fields (vat_id, po_number, billing_split), and SLA checkbox/credit table. Reply `create envelope` to proceed.

elaine_cs: Plan: 1) create envelope with EU Tax Annex + SLA Annex + invoice metadata fields 2) send to buyer 3) charge card auth for pilot after signature 4) finalize invoicing once PO and VAT ID received. Proceeding with `create envelope` unless objections.

matt_sales: No objections. I'll nudge procurement for VAT ID and PO ETA.

esign-bot: Envelope created: https://docusign.example/envelope/0xfe-halcyon-revcharge-sla. Routing: 1) Halcyon DE signer (attach KYC) 2) Halcyon US signer 3) Procurement CC 4) Finance ack.

elaine_cs: Sent to buyer. Action items: - matt_sales: chase PO + VAT ID - rachel_fin: prepare provisional invoice with `po: TBD` and mark auth on pilot - ian_legal: upload annexes to contract repo and confirm credit math with billing team.

elaine_cs: Will update thread when envelope signed or PO/VAT arrive. :white_check_mark:
